/**
 * HTTP Status Code Categories
 *
 * Groups status codes by their category (1xx-5xx).
 * All arrays are readonly for type safety.
 */

import type {
  InformationalStatusCode,
  SuccessfulStatusCode,
  RedirectionStatusCode,
  ClientErrorStatusCode,
  ServerErrorStatusCode,
} from './types.js';

// Informational 1xx
export const informational = [100, 101, 102, 103] satisfies InformationalStatusCode[];
export const INFORMATIONAL = informational;

// Successful 2xx
export const successful = [200, 201, 202, 203, 204, 205, 206, 207, 208, 226] satisfies SuccessfulStatusCode[];
export const SUCCESSFUL = successful;

// Redirection 3xx
export const redirection = [300, 301, 302, 303, 304, 305, 306, 307, 308] satisfies RedirectionStatusCode[];
export const REDIRECTION = redirection;

// Client Error 4xx
export const clientError = [
  400, 401, 402, 403, 404, 405, 406, 407, 408, 409, 410, 411, 412, 413, 414, 415, 416, 417, 418, 421, 422,
  423, 424, 425, 426, 428, 429, 431, 451,
] satisfies ClientErrorStatusCode[];
export const CLIENT_ERROR = clientError;

// Server Error 5xx
export const serverError = [500, 501, 502, 503, 504, 505, 506, 507, 508, 510, 511] satisfies ServerErrorStatusCode[];
export const SERVER_ERROR = serverError;

// All status codes
export const all = [...informational, ...successful, ...redirection, ...clientError, ...serverError] as const;
export const ALL = all;

/**
 * Get category name for a status code
 * @param code - HTTP status code
 * @returns Category name or 'Unknown'
 */
export function getCategory(code: number): string {
  const firstDigit = Math.floor(code / 100) as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5;
  return categories[firstDigit] ?? 'Unknown';
}

/**
 * Category names by first digit
 */
export const categories = {
  1: 'Informational',
  2: 'Successful',
  3: 'Redirection',
  4: 'Client Error',
  5: 'Server Error',
} as const;

/**
 * Check if code is informational (1xx)
 */
export function isInformational(code: number): code is InformationalStatusCode {
  return code >= 100 && code < 200;
}

/**
 * Check if code is successful (2xx)
 */
export function isSuccessful(code: number): code is SuccessfulStatusCode {
  return code >= 200 && code < 300;
}

/**
 * Check if code is redirection (3xx)
 */
export function isRedirection(code: number): code is RedirectionStatusCode {
  return code >= 300 && code < 400;
}

/**
 * Check if code is client error (4xx)
 */
export function isClientError(code: number): code is ClientErrorStatusCode {
  return code >= 400 && code < 500;
}

/**
 * Check if code is server error (5xx)
 */
export function isServerError(code: number): code is ServerErrorStatusCode {
  return code >= 500 && code < 600;
}

/**
 * Check if code is an error (4xx or 5xx)
 */
export function isError(code: number): boolean {
  return code >= 400 && code < 600;
}

/**
 * Check if code is valid (100-599)
 */
export function isValid(code: number): boolean {
  return code >= 100 && code < 600;
}
